 Karnataka MLC Election Results 2026: Vote Counting Begins for 4 Seats, Check Live Updates and Winners
 By Jasreet Kaur Last Updated: Oct 27, 2026, 12:15 IST Karnataka MLC Election Results 2026: Vote counting began on October 27 for four Legislative Council seats. Check live counting updates, candidate names and winners.
 Karnataka MLC Election Results 2026: Vote Counting Begins for 4 Seats, Check Live Updates and Winners 
 Counting of votes for four Karnataka Legislative Council seats began on October 27, 2026. Voting took place on October 23, with 43 candidates contesting the elections. The main contest is between the Congress and the BJP-Janata Dal (Secular) alliance. The results will decide the winners from two graduates and two teachers constituencies. Keep reading!
